content: Hello everyone! My name is Kris and I'm a CS student at UWaterloo with some experience in Rocq, Iris, and Lean. I was wondering how I can help with this project, and if there were any active issues that need help

Hi, great to hear that you are interested in Iris Lean! Not sure if there are currently specific topics to help, but what is always useful is if you try to use Iris Lean for something (e.g. related to your research) and then report / fix any issues / papercuts / missing things that you find.

Agreed with Michael. For the next week or so we will be trying to wrap up the main port of Iris and more contributors are not really the bottleneck at the moment. If you wanted to start porting some other Iris projects you find interesting that could be cool and rewarding!

Thanks! Is there any current work on porting Eris (https://arxiv.org/pdf/2404.14223) to Lean? If not this could be a fun project I would love to take on
